method: Manual identification from original source/native pixel panels. The retained indirect transform located comparison crops only; all native positions below were independently selected from actual native strokes. Seven architecture controls only will be fitted by unrobust projective least squares. Five architecture and three border features are held out; no threshold-based removal or role changes after fitting. F1 was changed from provisional fit to north architecture holdout before any new fit. H5 and B3 are rejected before fit because their intended landmarks are not identifiable in the native raster. All provisional plans and rejected features are retained.
